now.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2#14
now.text: Sunil Bakshi uses a Photostatic Veil to pose as Glenn Talbot and trick Coulson's team. Once Bakshi is caught, Coulson hands him over to Talbot, whose base he is later kidnapped from.
now.on_a_card_about_b: Hydra agent who impersonates Talbot, and is later kidnapped from Talbot's base.
now.on_b_card_about_a: General Bakshi impersonates, and from whose base he is taken.

proposed.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2#4
proposed.text: Sunil Bakshi uses a Photostatic Veil to pose as Glenn Talbot and trick Coulson's team.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Hydra agent who impersonates Talbot to trick Coulson's team.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: General Bakshi impersonates to trick Coulson's team.

changes.evidence: Bakshi impersonates Talbot with the Photostatic Veil at the Miami gala in S2#4 'Face My Enemy', so the stage's first fact holds there, not at S2#14. Coulson trades the captured Bakshi to Talbot in S2#11 'Aftershocks' (Morse and Hunter take him to be handed over), and Ward and Agent 33 kidnap him from Talbot's base in S2#14 'Love in the Time of Hydra'. Those later facts move to a later stage (see the added stage below) so the S2#4 stage does not spoil them.

proposed.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2#11
proposed.text: Once Bakshi is caught, Coulson trades him to Talbot, who wants him for Hydra's attacks and for posing as him.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Hydra agent Coulson hands over to Talbot.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: The general Coulson hands Bakshi over to.

changes.evidence: Split from stage 0 when it moves to S2#4. In S2#11 'Aftershocks' Coulson offers Bakshi to Talbot, who names the Navy wedding massacre, the U.N. attack and impersonating an officer; Morse and Hunter then take Bakshi to be handed over. (His kidnapping from Talbot's base by Ward and Agent 33 is S2#14 and could be a further stage if wanted.)

now.title: Spider-Man (1994)#10
now.text: Jameson fires Eddie twice over stories about Spider-Man, and Eddie blames the hero for ruining his life.
now.on_b_card_about_a: A rival photographer of Eddie's at the Bugle.

changes.evidence: Jameson first fires Eddie in an early Spider-Slayer episode after the fake Spider-Man unmasking, rehires him in #8 'The Alien Costume, Part 1', and fires him again in #9 'The Alien Costume, Part 2' when John reveals Eddie hid the Rhino; Eddie, evicted, blames Spider-Man. All of this happens before #10. Placed at #10 after the enemy stage, this 'rival' stage wrongly overrides the Venom enmity from #10 on (at the end of #10 Eddie is jailed in Ravencroft still bent on revenge, and returns as Venom in #37). Moving it to #9 puts it before stage 1 in story order.

now.title: Agent Carter S1#2
now.text: Daniel Sousa hunts Howard Stark for the SSR, which believes Howard sold his weapons to enemies overseas.
now.on_a_card_about_b: The inventor Sousa hunts as a suspected traitor.
now.on_b_card_about_a: An SSR agent hunting Howard on suspicion of selling weapons.

changes.evidence: The SSR's search for Howard begins in S1#1 'Now Is Not the End' after he skips the Congressional hearing about his weapons reaching enemies; Sousa sits in the briefing and the next day brings in photos of Stark on a boat for the Stark case. The stage's fact first holds in S1#1, not S1#2.

owner_calls.question: Stage 1 (X-Men '97#16) is 'boss', but Cooper dismisses Lorna from X-Factor in that episode and she returns to Xavier's school, so Cooper is no longer her boss after #16. Keep 'boss' as the record of her service, or change the kind?
owner_calls.evidence: S2E6 'Danger.exe' (#16): Cooper dismisses Polaris from X-Factor due to her volatility and she returns to the X-Mansion. X-Factor next clashes with the X-Men in #19.

owner_calls.question: Stage 0 (Luke Cage S2) is 'ally'. Luke storms Rosalie's office, beats her men and forces her to keep her business out of Harlem; in the finale she comes to Harlem's Paradise to set up a professional relationship with him as the new power. Is 'ally' right, or is 'rival' closer?
owner_calls.evidence: S2#13 'They Reminisce Over You': Luke threatens Rosalie into a deal; later she and Anibal meet him at Harlem's Paradise to discuss the underworld he now oversees.
